description: This file defines extension methods for the ISerializerBuilder interface, enabling support for JSON serialization using System.Text.Json. It includes methods to add JSON serializers with configurable options and type support delegates, and registers related services in a dependency injection container.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to enhance ISerializerBuilder with JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: AddJsonSerializer
methods.description: Adds support for serializing and deserializing values using System.Text.Json's JsonSerializer, with optional configuration for supported types and serializer options.

methods.name: AddJsonSerializer
methods.description: Overload that allows specifying separate delegates for serializable and copyable types, and optional configuration for JSON serializer options.
